highlights: Cookie banner over the sign-in form
notes: The authorize link lands on Adstudio's own sign-in page, split in two. On the left: the blue Adstudio wordmark, 'Welcome back', an email and password form with a solid blue Login button, then Login with Google and Login with Microsoft, and a sign-up link. On the right: a serif headline 'Welcome back to your ad accounts.' over a faint dotted pattern, with a preview of the Adstudio assistant. A cookie consent dialog covers the lower half of the page on first visit. Nothing on this screen mentions the MCP client yet; the consent step comes after sign-in.
